notes: Access: plain HTTP GET worked for every page (HTTP 200 throughout, no WAF/CAPTCHA/bot-block), robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow, consistent with prior Home-Decor pass for this company. Navigation discovery: fetched homepage and extracted the embedded mega-nav JSON (sub_navigation tree) - only ONE Bestsellers link is wired into the main site nav: 'Furniture' top-category -> sub_navigation 'Bestsellers' -> /collection/urban-ladder-bestsellers (118). No other top-level nav category exposes a Bestsellers child in the home nav JSON. Remaining candidates were found via the collections sitemap (https://www.urbanladder.com/sitemap/collections.sitemap.xml, 1017 collection URLs) using target-term slug matching (best*, top-sellers-on-*, bestselling-*), then each was opened and validated: confirmed real product grids (h1 + 'N Products' badge + JSON-LD product names), not editorial/PDP pages. Cross-linkage check: fetched /collection/sofa-sets and /collection/living-room-furnitures (real category PLPs) and confirmed they link out to bestselling-sofas / bestselling-fabric-sofas / bestselling-shoe-racks - proving these per-category Bestseller pages are genuine site-exposed listings, not orphans, even though they are not nested under the main 'Bestsellers' nav node (they are parallel, flat collections, not a grouping tree), so no row is marked is_group. Dropped per 'zero-product listings dropped' rule: top-sellers-on-livingroom (0 Products) and top-sellers-on-living (0 Products) - both loaded fine but the site's own badge reports 0. Excluded as out-of-scope (checked, not bestseller concept): best-buy-under-15000, best-buy-under-5000, best-buys-under-10000, best-buys-under-10k, best-buy-bedroom-collection, best-buy-livingroom-collection, engineered-wood-best-buys - all are PRICE-threshold 'good value' collections ('Best Buy'=budget pick under a rupee ceiling), not a bestselling/popularity merchandising concept, despite the 'best' substring in the slug. Also excluded todays-best-deals (19 Products, titled 'Todays Best Deals') - this is the 'Deal Zone > Top Deals' daily-deals concept (discount-driven), not a bestseller listing. Also excluded latest-sofa-set-designs (8576 Products, titled 'Latest Sofa Set Designs') - far too large to be a curated bestseller/new list; 'Latest' here is a marketing term for 'current catalogue of designs', not a recency or popularity concept; this is effectively the full sofa catalogue under a styling headline. Caution flags: 'bestsellers' (47), 'urban-ladder-bestsellers' (118) and 'urban-ladder-bestseller' singular (13) are three distinctly-counted, confusingly near-identically-named Bestseller pages; spot-checked product-name overlap between urban-ladder-bestseller(13) and urban-ladder-bestsellers(118) showed several shared SKUs (Florence Lounge Chair, Caribu Dining Table, Bennis Shoe Rack), suggesting urban-ladder-bestseller (13) may be a stale/legacy leftover subset rather than a deliberately distinct listing - kept as its own row (different exact count, so not a provable alias) but flagged for human dedup review. 'Dawn' and 'Multi Brand' bestsellers are genuine sub-brand/marketplace-seller bestseller listings (Urban Ladder's storefront runs on the Reliance 'Swadesh Online' multi-brand platform per the prior pass's notes) - verified with real, distinct product grids. No local-language (Hindi, etc.) equivalents found in nav/search; site is English-only.
